mapper.select: SELECT b.bb_idx, b.bb_title, o.or_name, b.bb_reg_date, b.bb_hit, b.bb_open FROM sianadb.market.bbs b LEFT JOIN sianadb.market.org o ON b.bb_or_idx = o.or_idx WHERE o.or_name IS NOT NULL

SELECT b.bb_idx, b.bb_title, o.or_name, b.bb_reg_date, b.bb_hit, b.bb_open FROM sianadb.market.bbs b LEFT JOIN sianadb.market.org o ON b.bb_or_idx = o.or_idx WHERE 1=1
and bb_or_idx = #{bbOrIdx}
and bb_reg_date between #{strDate}::timestamp
and #{endDate}::timestamp
and now()
and bb_mod_date between #{strDate}::timestamp
and #{endDate}::timestamp
and now()
and bb_title like CONCAT('%', #{bbTitle}, '%')
SELECT O.OR_IDX, O.OR_ID, O.OR_NAME, O.OR_LEVEL, O.OR_CONTEST_STATUS, O.OR_RND_STATUS, O.OR_RND_STATUS, O.OR_IP_INTRO, O.OR_SEQ, O.OR_GB, O.OR_SEARCH_GROUP FROM SIANADB.MARKET.ORG O ORDER BY OR_SEQ

SELECT B.BB_IDX, B.BB_NOTICE, B.BB_OR_IDX, B.BB_TITLE, B.BB_CONTENT, B.BB_OPEN, B.BB_REG_DATE, B.BB_HIT FROM SIANADB.MARKET.BBS B LEFT JOIN SIANADB.MARKET.ORG O ON B.BB_OR_IDX = O.OR_IDX WHERE B.BB_IDX = #{bbIdx}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SIANADB.MARKET.BBS( BB_BBSID, BB_OR_IDX, BB_TYPE, BB_TITLE, BB_CONTENT, BB_SEQ, BB_HIT, BB_NOTICE, BB_OPEN, BB_CONFIRM, BB_STATUS, BB_OPEN_TYPE, BB_CO_IDX, BB_REG_DATE, BB_REG_ID, BB_REG_IP ) VALUES ( #{bbBbsid}, #{bbOrIdx}, #{bbType}, #{bbTitle}, #{bbContent}, #{bbSeq}, #{bbHit}, #{bbNotice}, #{bbOpen}, #{bbConfirm}, #{bbStatus}, #{bbOpenType}, #{bbCoIdx}, now(), #{bbRegId}, #{bbRegIp} )

INSERT INTO SIANADB.MARKET.BBS_FILE ( BF_BBSID, BF_BB_IDX, BF_SRC, BF_ORG_NAME, BF_NAME, BF_EXT, BF_SIZE, BF_SEQ, BF_REG_DATE, BF_REG_ID, BF_REG_IP ) VALUES
( #{file.bfBbsid}, #{file.bfBbIdx}, #{file.bfSrc}, #{file.bfOrgName}, #{file.bfName}, #{file.bfExt}, #{file.bfSize}, #{file.bfSeq}, now(), #{file.bfRegId}, #{file.bfRegIp} )
